messages:
zoe: Who's coming to the big-screen playoff watch in the lounge tonight? I'm bringing noise-makers and terrible predictions.

eli: I'll be there. Bringing a thermos of coffee and an irrational hope for unterdog energy.

priya: Count me in, but I demand a halftime meme slideshow. Someone curate please. :laughing: 

score-bot: ScoreBot: Reminder - Lounge projector reserved from 7:00pm to 10:30pm. Capacity 18.

jack: I made a tiny office pool for the game: $2 entry, winner gets a $10 coffee card + bragging rights. DM me to join.

sophie: Joined the pool. Also pro tip: stash extra hoodies, it's going to be chilly in the lounge.

marco: Can we get chips? I will absolutely not share my emergency hot sauce unless bribed.

zoe: Poll: chips tier? blue bag (classic), guac & chips, or pretzels.

eli: guac & chips pls.

priya: pretzels (srsly less crumbly on keyboards).

jack: classic blue bag here. Also: fantasy waiver reminder - last add before lock at 8:45pm.

score-bot: LeagueBot: Waiver window closes in 45 minutes. Trades locked at 9pm.

marco: Halftime challenge idea: predict the next scorer for a $1 side bet? Low stakes, max chaos.

zoe: I will lose money and dignity. In.

eli: GIF suggestion thread: post the best reaction GIF when our team misses an open net. Winner gets a cookie.

sophie: Here is my submission: :giphy: dramatic-facepalm

priya: Also logistics — who's picking up pizza? I can swing by Roberto's on my way. What toppings?

jack: Two large: one pepperoni + mushrooms, one half-meatball/half-veggie. One order of wings.

marco: Can someone add a GF pizza? I'm trying to be considerate.

eli: I'll order a 10" GF. DM me $$ if you want in.

zoe: Bringing string lights and the 'historic upset' banner. Someone photoshop a mascot hat on it pls.

priya: Uploaded a terrible banner draft to #memes. It's peak.

score-bot: SnackBot: Pizza ordered for 7:15pm. Delivery ETA 7:40pm.

jack: Pool status: 12 entries so far. Final call at kickoff. Good luck, may RNG be kind.

marco: Also, if anyone wants to borrow my extra charging cable, it's in the lounge bag. Please return.

eli: Reminder: parking on the 3rd level is limited after 7. Leave early if you want a spot.

zoe: Alright team — live memes, low-key gambling, and snacks. This is my kind of company culture. See y'all tonight.
